chunks.text: Explainer · May 23, twenty twenty-six · 6 min read · By Don Goldstein

ChatGPT still sends the most AI referral traffic, but its share is falling while Gemini's climbs fast. For a restaurant, Gemini is the more winnable of the two, because it reads the Google profile you already manage.
In short
ChatGPT still sends the most AI referral traffic but its share is falling (89.2% to 81.4%); Gemini rose from 4.3% to 11.6% in Q1 twenty twenty-six and 13.2% by April.
Gemini is the most winnable AI source for a restaurant because it reads Google's own ecosystem, your profile, Maps, and reviews.
Keep the Google Business Profile complete and current and it feeds three surfaces at once: the map pack, the AI Overview, and Gemini.

4.3% to 13.2% in a single quarter. That is Gemini’s share of AI referral traffic, roughly tripling between January and April twenty twenty-six, while ChatGPT, still the leader, slid from 89.2% to 81.4% over the same stretch. Two numbers, two directions. The short version for a restaurant: Gemini is now the clear number 2 AI referral source, it is bigger than every other non-ChatGPT assistant combined, and it is the more winnable of the two, because it reads the Google profile you already manage. The rest of this piece is the data behind that, and what to do with it this week.

A single half-dial reading Gemini's share of all AI referral traffic in April twenty twenty-six. The needle sits at thirteen point two percent on a zero-to-one-hundred-percent scale, a small slice of the whole, but the second-largest one, and larger than every non-ChatGPT assistant added together. A quarter earlier the same number was four point three percent, so the needle has more than tripled its reading in three months. The dial is the snapshot; the tripling is the story.

Hold the snapshot next to the trend. The dial above is one moment; the chart below is the direction of travel for both leaders at once, the April level as a bar, with a tick marking where each source started the quarter. Read the gap between bar and tick, not the bar alone.

Share of AI referral traffic, where each bar shows the April twenty twenty-six level and a tick marks where that source started the quarter, so you read the direction of travel. ChatGPT is at about eighty-one percent in April; the tick sits further right at over eighty-nine percent, so the bar has pulled back from its start, ChatGPT is sliding. Gemini is at about thirteen percent in April; its start-of-quarter tick sits far to the left near four percent, so the bar has surged past where it began, Gemini is climbing fast. Every other assistant combined is roughly five percent and barely moved. The story is not the snapshot; it is the two arrows pointing in opposite directions.

Same dataset, opposite arrows: ChatGPT sliding from 89.2% toward 81.4%, Gemini climbing from 4.3% past 13.2%. You do not have to pick the winner, you have to notice that the riser is the one whose ranking surface is already on your to-do list.
Why Gemini is the winnable one.

Here is the part that matters for a restaurant: Gemini reads Google’s own ecosystem. When it answers “good ramen near me,” it leans on your Google Business Profile , your Maps presence, and your reviews, the exact assets you already manage. ChatGPT and Perplexity pull from a wider, messier web you have far less control over. So the same profile work that helps you show up in a Google AI Overview also feeds Gemini. You are not optimizing for a new platform; you are getting paid twice for the one you already work on.

How Gemini composes an answer about a restaurant. Step one: a diner types a question like good ramen near me into Gemini. Step two: Gemini looks up the Google Business Profile, the Maps listing, and the recent reviews for nearby restaurants. Step three: Gemini composes a short answer naming the places whose profiles it could read. Step four: your restaurant is named, or a competitor is, depending on which profile was complete enough to lift an answer from.
How to see it, and earn more of it.

First, look. In your analytics, AI assistants show up as referrals from hosts like gemini.google.com and chatgpt.com ; if you have never checked, that is the number to start watching. The Search Console walkthrough shows where to find the search side of it.

Then earn it the cheap way: keep the Google profile complete and current, because for Gemini that profile is the ranking surface. Run the G B P grader for the gaps, the S E O grader for the on-site signals that back the profile up, and search ideas for the questions worth answering in text. The setup basics, if the profile is new, are in setting up your Google Business Profile .

From the floor

I started watching the referrer line in our analytics the way I watch a reservation book, a quick glance, same time each week. gemini.google.com was not even a row a year ago; now it sits just under chatgpt.com and climbs most weeks. What struck me on the floor is how little new work it asked for. The hours, the cuisine tags, the menu link I keep current so a guest can find us on Maps, that is the same file Gemini reads before it names anyone. I was already doing the work; I just was not getting credit for it on a surface I had not thought to check.
What to do this week.

The practical move is not “learn Gemini.” It is to keep the Google profile complete and current, because that one profile is now feeding three surfaces at once: the map pack, the AI Overview, and the fastest-growing AI referral source you have. Three small moves, in order:

Three moves to earn more Gemini referrals this week. One: open your analytics and look for referrals from hosts like gemini dot google dot com and chatgpt dot com, note today's number so you can watch it move. Two: run the G B P grader and close every blank field it flags, hours, cuisine, attributes, menu link, booking link. Three: pick three questions a diner would actually ask and confirm the answer exists in plain text on your own pages, then run the S E O grader to back it up.
Key takeaways
Gemini is the clear number 2 AI referral source, bigger than every other non-ChatGPT assistant combined.
The same Google Business Profile work pays twice, for Google's AI Overview and for Gemini.
AI assistants show up in analytics as referrals from hosts like gemini.google.com; start watching that number.
Optimizing for Gemini is mostly optimizing the Google profile you already manage.
